scope: Source-only visual events fixed before R125 output; evaluation only. Neither prompt nor temporal routing uses these annotations.

events.name: 切下的一片开始向外倒下
events.definition: 切片与主体分开并开始向画面右前方明显倒下；按切片运动状态判定。

events.name: 转动剩余甜椒
events.definition: 持椒手将剩余主体由切面朝镜头转向侧面，进入下一次切割的准备。

events.name: 刀刃抬回甜椒顶部
events.definition: 刀刃从较低位置回到剩余甜椒的顶部附近，准备下一次下刀。

source_review: Root inspected 24-frame context covering original0–109 and all original50–109 at640x360.
task_criterion: Wooden cutting board changes to marble while hands, yellow pepper, cut sequence, objects and camera arrangement remain.
censoring_rule: Record NOT_OBSERVED_WITHIN_VALID_CLIP if matching event has not occurred by frame105; do not substitute repeated frame106 as a measured event.
uncertainty: Visual event brackets describe annotation resolution. Later two transitions occur within the same repositioning motion and are reported per event.
